operating_notes.text: Vehicle Finance AUM ₹1,19,558 Cr (+18% YoY) with Q4FY26 NIM at 8.7% and loan losses at 1.6% of assets.
Gold loan book grew to ₹1,804 Cr in FY26 from ₹573 Cr, with Stage 3 at 0.02%.
Branch network at 1,761 across 26 states and 7 union territories, 88% in Tier-III to Tier-VI towns.
Q4 FY26 disbursements reached ₹32,913 Cr (+25% YoY), taking total AUM to ₹2,42,630 Cr (+21% YoY).
Gold loan per-branch AUM is ₹12-15 Cr; 90% of gold loan customers are new to Chola and yields are ~16-17%, on par with peers.
CSEL net credit cost fell to 4.7% from 6.7% and pretax ROA is 3.3%; SBPL pretax ROA is 7.9% with Stage 3 at 2.3%.
Collections employ around 30,000 people; 55% of CSEL collections are digital.
